findings.issue: The app ships zero tests: no test script, no runner dependency, no spec files anywhere in app/src.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest plus @testing-library/svelte or a small Playwright component suite; start by unit-testing pokeapi.js transforms and the +page.server.js load functions with a mocked fetch.

findings.issue: URL-state sync only runs on popstate; the page-clamp (46-47), param-omission (41-49) and filter-reset logic are untested, and a refactor here easily desynchronizes state and URL.
findings.suggestion: Extract filter/pagination/query-URL logic into pure functions and unit-test them (e.g. clamping, omitting defaults, back/forward round-trips).

findings.issue: cardsFromPokemonRefs silently drops unresolved species and excludes ids >= 10000; regressions here make cards disappear from move/ability/type pages without any error.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with fixture refs covering alternate forms, duplicates, and out-of-index ids; assert the exact sorted card list.

findings.issue: Sorting logic (missing-last in both directions, tie-breaks, aria-sort) is subtle and untested; the both-missing tie-break at line 60 is not direction-flipped while other tie-breaks are.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator with rows containing null power/accuracy/level in both directions, and assert aria-sort behaviour.

findings.issue: +error.svelte renders 'Not found' for every error status, masking API outages (pokeapi.js:23-26 throws plain Error → 500) as 404s.
findings.suggestion: Branch on page.status; render 'Not found' only for 404 and something else for 5xx, and add a test that a failing API yields a distinguishable page.

findings.issue: The memo caches null (404) results forever and has no eviction; under the spec's live-API premise, stale 404s or renamed resources would be served indefinitely with nothing to catch it.
findings.suggestion: Add a TTL or 404-negative-cache timeout, and unit-test the cache (hit, miss, rejection clears entry).

findings.issue: Moves-table assembly (per-method grouping, method ordering, default game at 92-93) is untested, and the spec's default row order actually depends on MoveTable's initial sortKey (MoveTable.svelte:30-31) rather than server-side ordering — a fragile cross-file coupling.
findings.suggestion: Sort rows server-side for the default order and unit-test the load function with a fixture pokemon payload.

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText exists but is unused; the same whitespace-collapsing logic is duplicated inline at pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:51-53 and moves/[name]/+page.server.js:24-27.
findings.suggestion: Use the shared helper everywhere and unit-test it (whitespace collapse, no-English-entry case).

findings.issue: humanize drives display names everywhere but is untested for edge cases (empty segments, digits, unicode).
findings.suggestion: A three-line unit test pins the 'mr-mime' → 'Mr Mime' contract the spec depends on.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own; every safety net is the external acceptance suite. The most refactor-hostile logic — the pokeapi.js data transforms, moves-table assembly, MoveTable sorting, and home-page filter/URL-state code — is pure and easily testable but entirely unguarded, so a data-layer refactor could break card lists, ordering, and URL sync with no failing test. Error handling also masks 5xx as 'Not found', a bug a single test would expose.

untested.likelyBug: Cards silently vanish from move/ability/type pages after a refactor (dedupe, id>=10000 exclusion, species-index resolution); wrong type-slot or generation attribution would render correct-looking but wrong filters.

untested.area: Home filtering, pagination and URL query state (app/src/routes/+page.svelte:31-107)
untested.likelyBug: State/URL desync: popstate-only sync missing other navigation types, page clamp diverging from the URL, or default params (empty q, page=1) reappearing in the URL.

untested.area: MoveTable column sorting, missing-value ordering and aria-sort (app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:54-104)
untested.likelyBug: Missing power/accuracy/level rows jumping to the top in descending order, tie-breaks flipping inconsistently, or aria-sort leaking to non-sorted headers.

untested.area: Pokémon page load function: default game selection, per-method move grouping, method order, stat total (app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:60-148)
untested.likelyBug: Default game ceasing to be the highest-order version group, or methods losing the Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor ordering when METHOD_ORDER indexing changes.

API 500s rendered as 'Not found' pages, hiding outages; a missing evolution_chain fallback (pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:167-170) silently fabricating data.
